description: PostgreSQL 18 bytea storage, input/output, functions, ordering, and indexes
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_bytea (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload BYTEA UNIQUE);
SELECT id, payload, encode(payload, 'hex'), length(payload), octet_length(payload), bit_length(payload), bit_count(payload) FROM type_matrix_bytea ORDER BY payload;

SELECT '\x00ff'::bytea || '\x415c'::bytea AS concatenated, get_byte('\x00ff415c'::bytea, 1) AS byte_1, get_bit('\x01'::bytea, 0) AS bit_0, set_byte('\x00ff'::bytea, 0, 171) AS changed_byte, set_bit('\x00'::bytea, 7, 1) AS changed_bit;

SELECT substring('\x0011223344'::bytea FROM 2 FOR 3) AS sliced, reverse('\x00ff415c'::bytea) AS reversed, md5('\x00ff'::bytea) AS md5, sha256('abc'::bytea) AS sha256, crc32('abc'::bytea) AS crc32, crc32c('abc'::bytea) AS crc32c;
SELECT '\x00ff'::bytea < '\x0100'::bytea AS byte_order, '\x00ff'::bytea < '\x00ff00'::bytea AS prefix_order, encode(decode('AP9BXA==', 'base64'), 'hex') AS base64_roundtrip;

SELECT substring('\x00010203'::bytea FROM 0 FOR 2) AS zero_start, position('\x0203'::bytea IN '\x0001020304'::bytea) AS byte_position, overlay('\x0001020304'::bytea PLACING '\xaabb'::bytea FROM 2 FOR 2) AS overlaid, btrim('\x0001000002'::bytea, '\x0002'::bytea) AS trimmed;

SELECT convert_from('\x636166c3a9'::bytea, 'UTF8') AS decoded_text, encode(convert_to('café', 'UTF8'), 'hex') AS encoded_text, encode(convert('\x636166e9'::bytea, 'LATIN1', 'UTF8'), 'hex') AS transcoded, encode(decode(E'AAEC\nAwQ=', 'base64'), 'hex') AS folded_base64;
SELECT payload FROM type_matrix_bytea WHERE payload = '\x00ff415c'::bytea;
